verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API, a CLI and an MCP server, so the story's axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows API versioning (e.g. versioned endpoints or headers) or a documented deprecation policy. The only version reference is an anytype-heart middleware release number tied to chat features, which is not an API versioning or deprecation commitment, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.
